profile.subtitleJa: ヨナダブの父として名が挙げられる。
profile.summaryJa: 列王記下10:15は、エフーがレカブの子ヨナダブと出会ったと記します。
profile.identityNoteJa: 同名のサウル王の配下やネヘミヤ記の人物とは区別し、ヨナダブの父として言及されるレカブを指します。

facts.textJa: エフーとヨナダブはバアルの家へ入り、主に仕える者がそこにいないか調べました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”
